forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: doing
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: A gated probe that nests an unguided generation inside a tool call, to name the layer the deadlock lives in
+---
+A gated scenario hangs for ever (0% CPU, ~19GB resident) when both profile slots name one `ModelRef`, because `searchTools` generates from inside the outer turn's tool call.
+
+Two explanations compete:
+
+- **MLX**: the nested GRAMMAR-CONSTRAINED decode deadlocks (xgrammar shared per-model caches).
+- **Router**: `RoutedModel.generationGate` — an `AsyncSemaphore(value: 1)` minted per resident container — is taken by `beginTurn()` and held for the WHOLE turn, tool calls included. A nested `respond` on the same container parks on `generationGate.wait()` and can never be admitted: the permit is freed by `endTurn()`, which needs the tool call to return, which needs the nested respond. `AsyncSemaphore.wait()` is a bare `withCheckedContinuation` with no cancellation handler, so the park is silent, burns no CPU, and cannot be killed.
+
+Router's explanation needs NO grammar. The MLX one needs one. That is the discriminator.
+
+## Subtasks
+
+- [ ] A fixture tool whose `call(arguments:)` opens a plain, ungrammared session on the SAME resolved slot the outer turn runs on, and calls `respond(to:)`.
+- [ ] Mount ONLY that tool — no `searchTools`, no `MultiTool`, no selection tier, no `MetadataSearcher`.
+- [ ] Drive one turn through `RoutedSession.streamEvents`, as the other gated scenarios do.
+- [ ] `CallTrace` spans over the nested respond, so an entry with no exit names the hang.
+- [ ] `.timeLimit(.minutes(3))`, matching the canary, so a hang reports fast.
+- [ ] Sample `generationGate.availablePermits` / `waiterCount` during the turn, if reachable without editing `../FoundationModelsRouter`.
+- [ ] Run it gated with both slots pinned to `Muse-Glimmer-30B-4bit` (cached), then restore the pin byte for byte.
+
+## Reading
+
+- HANGS with no grammar: Router's gate deadlock is confirmed, the MLX/xgrammar explanation is dead.
+- COMPLETES with no grammar: the grammar matters, and the MLX explanation stands.</description>
+<parameter name="tags">["eventplan"]
\ No newline at end of file

@@ -1,6 +1,48 @@
 ---
 assignees:
 - claude-code
+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m05c3pv8sssrmns01s8wcds7
+  text: |-
+    Probe built and run twice. **It hangs with no grammar anywhere. Router's generation gate is the deadlock; the MLX/xgrammar explanation is not needed to account for it.**
+
+    Run 1 (08:15) and run 2 (08:22), both with `TinyModels.generation` temporarily pinned to `mlx-community/Muse-Glimmer-30B-4bit` (the cached 18GB checkpoint) and `selection = generation`, so both slots named one model:
+
+    ```
+    GATE permits=1 waiters=0      <- before the turn
+    GATE permits=0 waiters=0      <- beginTurn() took the permit
+    GATE permits=0 waiters=1      <- x33, to the end of the run
+    ✘ Time limit was exceeded: 180.000 seconds
+    SCENARIO [nestedGeneration] result=FAIL nestedCallEntered=pass nestedGenerationReturned=fail
+    NESTED-GENERATION [nestedGeneration] elapsed=175.0s entered=["checkModelReadiness"] returned=[] reply=""
+    ```
+
+    Unified log, `subsystem == "com.swissarmyhammer.multitool" AND category == "NestedGenerationProbe"`:
+
+    ```
+    run 1: 08:15:49.698 enter nestedRespond #1 checkModelReadiness
+           08:18:34.135 exit  nestedRespond #1 threw CancellationError()     (165.4s)
+    run 2: 08:22:33.690 enter nestedRespond #1 checkModelReadiness
+           08:25:20.231 exit  nestedRespond #1 threw CancellationError()     (166.5s)
+    ```
+
+    Router's check 2 is reachable from our side, through `@testable import FoundationModelsRouter` alone — `RoutedModel.generationGate`, `AsyncSemaphore.availablePermits` and `AsyncSemaphore.waiterCount` are all `internal`. No sibling package was edited.
+
+    What the reading rests on:
+
+    - The probe carries **no grammar**: `slot.makeSession()` with every argument defaulted, `respond(to:maxTokens:)`, no guided session, no selection tier, no `MetadataSearcher`. Only `IntegrationNestedGenerationTool` is mounted — `searchTools` and `MultiTool` are not in the picture.
+    - The tool output is `@Generable`, not `String`, so Router's mount leaves the call **in band** rather than wrapping it in `DetachingTool`. A detached body would run outside the turn holding the permit and could not deadlock.
+    - The exit is a `CancellationError` that arrives only once the suite's time limit cancels the outer turn — which is the mechanism itself: `endTurn()` is what hands the permit back, and cancelling the turn is what let the parked waiter through.
+
+    Nested `respond` is not cancellable on its own account, but it does unwind once the outer turn is cancelled — so the park is not unkillable, it is unresolvable while the turn lives.
+
+    Discovery, and a defect it exposed in the probe's own evidence: `ScenarioCallLog.invokedPaths` is computed off `calls`, which is appended to on the way *out*, so run 1 reported `entered=[]` for a call that had been open 165 seconds — the same reading a model that never called the tool produces, and the opposite conclusion. Added `ScenarioCallLog.enteredPaths`, recorded before `body()`; `invokedPaths` and every existing reader are untouched. Run 2 confirms the corrected line.
+
+    The gated probe **fails today**, by design: it is the regression test for the layer it named and it will pass when the gate admits a nested generation. That is stated in the suite's own documentation so nobody reads it as a broken test.
+
+    Pin restored byte for byte: `IntegrationGate.swift` md5 `ca222474b51e278f08e918367078fb29` before and after, `git diff` on that file is empty.
+  timestamp: 2026-08-16T13:27:51.912412+00:00
